title: S2 adapter: finite runtime outputs -> producer receipts (the producer/consumer boundary)
objective: Implement the small adapter that turns finite-world executions and ruler/gate outcomes into producer receipts, so the consumer sees only receipts and bytes across the boundary.
problem: Closure F and plan s2 S2: one finite transition fixture with a producer and consumer receipt boundary and a small adapter. The adapter records code/inputs/outputs identities, execution status and resources (plan s3 Receipt) and never sets authority or outcome fields itself beyond what the ruler/gate returned.
non_goals: No universal runtime adapter (plan s1: no universal runtime)
Do not copy code, tests or verdict policies from the Fable or ASTRA harnesses; they are reference and adversarial corpora (SOURCES.md B; NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s1)
Python >= 3.8 standard library only; no package installation (MWO-0004 R2)
evidence_required: RED: a round-trip test (world run -> receipt -> checker) fails before the adapter exists
GREEN: round trip passes; a cheat control shows the consumer refuses a receipt whose recorded outputs differ from the bytes supplied
